reason: Initial per-crate floors, copied unchanged from the proposal the floor printed when CI first ran it on this host; each floor is the line coverage measured there. Measured on aarch64-apple-darwin on macos14/ARM64, rustc 1.98.1 (48a229cea 2026-09-01), cargo-llvm-cov 0.9.0, https://github.com/D0n9X1n/SonicTerm/actions/runs/36085508452, commit c70683e2c165c54d51d02309e6a48af846dd03c7. That commit is GitHub's test merge of pull-request head c209d050b0442d0b4f87150342bbc393e85aab79 onto main at 40b0f2bd17230a1684a1a11d72d9eb674b9079e0, with the head's tree. A crate fails when its coverage falls more than 1.0 percentage points below its floor.

not_measured.sonicterm-fontconfig: declarations only: src/lib.rs holds hand-written Fontconfig FFI types, constants, and extern declarations with no function body, so it has no instrumented line; sonicterm-font links it only on non-macOS Unix, so it is also target-inapplicable on this host.
not_measured.sonicterm-harfbuzz: generated only: src/lib.rs, its only library source, is rust-bindgen output counted under generated code; build.rs compiles the HarfBuzz C/C++ sources, which Rust coverage does not instrument.
